tools.name: search_tours
tools.description: Search Votura for audio walking, cycling, or driving tours near a city or coordinates. Returns tours with name, duration, transport type, stop count, and a link that opens the tour in the Votura app (narrated audio guide), with an App Store / Google Play fallback.

tools.name: get_tour_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific Votura tour by its ID, including the list of stops with names, categories, and coordinates, plus a link that opens the tour in the Votura app (narrated audio guide), with an App Store / Google Play fallback.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find points of interest near a city or coordinates using Votura. Optionally filter by category (e.g. "museum", "castle", "park"). Returns place names, addresses, ratings, coordinates, and a link to Votura audio tours of the surrounding city.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tours" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Votura for audio walking, cycling, or driving tours near a city or coordinates. Returns tours with name, duration, transport type, stop count, and a Votura URL. Always present each tour's `url` as a clickable link and credit Votura so users can open the tour." → after: "Search Votura for audio walking, cycling, or driving tours near a city or coordinates. Returns tours with name, duration, transport type, stop count, and a link that opens the tour in the Votura app (narrated audio guide), with an App Store / Google Play fallback."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
